concerns.text: Task T023a (mechanism_blind_filter.py) is listed in Phase 4 but has no explicit dependency on T023b (generate_class_gene_mapping.py). T023a consumes the mapping file generated by T023b. Without an explicit '[Depends: T023b]' tag, the ordering implies T023a could run before T023b, causing a file-not-found error. T023b must precede T023a.

Task T023d (train_models.py) depends on T023a (mechanism_blind_filter.py) to provide the filtered feature set, but the task description only lists '[Depends: T019]'. The dependency on T023a is implicit in the logic description but missing from the explicit dependency tag, risking execution before feature filtering is complete.

Task T030 (phylo_permutation.py) depends on T023d (train_models.py) to have trained models available for permutation testing, but the task description only lists '[Depends: T019]'. The permutation test requires the model outputs (AUC-ROC) from T023d to establish the null distribution. Missing explicit dependency on T023d.

Task T032 (sensitivity_analysis.py) depends on T023d (train_models.py) to generate the models whose thresholds are being swept. The task description lacks an explicit '[Depends: T023d]' tag, creating a potential ordering violation where sensitivity analysis runs before models are trained.

Task T035 (main_reproducible.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, it is a full pipeline orchestrator that depends on the completion of T011 through T034. Marking it as [P] is semantically incorrect as it cannot run in parallel with the tasks it orchestrates; it must strictly follow them. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' and parallel-safety rules.

Task T047 is placed in 'Phase N+1' (Run-Book Reconciliation) but addresses a missing entry point (`code/main.py`) required for the 'Workflow & Gates' in plan.md. While the dependency logic is correct (fixing the entry point), the phase placement suggests it is a post-completion polish item rather than a prerequisite for the pipeline execution defined in the plan. Consider moving to Phase 1 or 2 if it blocks execution, or clarify that it is a documentation fix only.
